item.title: New K100 banknote featuring Sir Julius Chan launched in Port Moresby
item.description: The Bank of Papua New Guinea has officially launched the new K100 banknote today, issued in honour of the late former Prime Minister, Sir Julius Chan. item.title: Theodist Lae to host BBQ Fundraiser to rebuild storm-damaged classrooms
item.description: THE Theodist Business Superstore (TBS) in Lae is taking another step ahead in its community corporate obligation to raise funding for six classrooms destroyed by a strong wind last Thursday. The TBS will be hosting a barbeque fundraising drive at its carpark next to BSP Commercial branch, Down Town along the Markham Drive on Saturday 31. item.description: Today was a significant day for Papua New Guinea, the people of New Ireland, and most importantly, the Chan family, as the face of their late father, Sir Julius Chan, was unveiled on the newly launched K100 note. item.title: Irangarang Association Inc. launched to empower Markham landowners
item.description: An association was launched last Thursday, marking a significant milestone in the community’s collective effort to promote and safeguard landowner rights, ensure equitable benefit-sharing, and foster a harmonious working relationship with Ramu Agri-Industries Limited (RAIL).
